description: This PHP file defines the SaveEmailSubscriptionController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and handles the pre-render logic for editing an email subscription. Specifically, it checks if a subscription ID is present in the request attributes and sets up a corresponding Vue component with that ID.

classes.name: SaveEmailSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller that manages the pre-render phase for editing email subscription details; extends AbstractVueController to use Vue.js components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that initializes a Vue component with the subscription ID if available in the request attributes.
